items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] know? There is one more bass player, this man from the other side of the river, Twop, they [INTERVIEWEE] call him. Oh, yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: Well, that's what I'm telling you, man. I mean, you know, and then the question of it is, you see, if he was playing the bass 21 years old or something, and when you get older you change your style, maybe it would've last longer. But no, you see, I mean, if he'd sit up there like, now old man Lewis James, he's going to kill himself and he's going to sit up there and do that. After a while he's going to try, but his music gets to punch and then he'll go again, you see? I mean, he just does something to you. Yeah.…
